invariants.claim: At a sampling edge, an active prior-stage token advances to last stage on the same edge, carrying its unchanged tag.
invariants.RTL_basis: stage_tag[last] <= source_tag from stage_tag[last-1] and stage_valid[last] <= stage_valid[last-1]
invariants.checked: actual stage/round/tag shadow in both views

invariants.claim: A context tag has at most one in-flight token, so the prior-stage metadata read cannot share a tag with a simultaneous last-stage return or acceptance.
invariants.RTL_basis: busy excludes accepting an active tag except after completed response; again creates feedback only as old token leaves last
invariants.checked: normal-view duplicate-token/acceptance assertions plus P2/P4 batch shadow

invariants.claim: Per-slot phase/node/more/iteration/steps/capture/initial metadata stay stable from prior-stage sampling until last-stage consumption.
invariants.RTL_basis: slot metadata writes occur only on acceptance or its last-stage permutation return; neither can overlap that slot in prior stage
invariants.checked: all 18 functional bits compared against true baseline at consumption in normal and SYNTHESIS views

invariants.claim: For P2, the prior stage is stage0; accepted or feedback metadata was written on the preceding edge and is visible before sampling.
invariants.checked: P2 normal/SYNTHESIS 459 recipes each, 12 batch scenarios per view with 12-pass recycle

invariants.claim: Common family/coordinates change only after all busy/captured results drain; prefetched metadata is overwritten by the next valid token before any next-job return.
invariants.checked: explicit no-reset two-job family/q switch in COORDINATE_VALIDATION.json

scope: Reset-generated legal ready/valid protocol, one in-flight token per active tag. Arbitrary invalid mid-flight metadata overwrite or duplicate-tag protocol violations are not equivalence claims.
